device.description: Self-calibrating 12-bit plus sign 2-channel serial I/O ADC with MUX and sample/hold
device.note: adc12130.pdf (SNAS098G) p.2 connection diagram (16-pin), p.3-4 pin descriptions, p.5 operating ratings, p.9-10 conversion and acquisition times, p.11 digital timing, p.28-29 Tables 1, 3, 4 (data out formats, multiplexer addressing, mode programming), p.30 Table 6 status register, p.31-32 digital interface, p.39 output code examples

registers.name: STATUS
registers.note: Table 6, DB0 (first bit out) = bit 8 ... DB8 = bit 0; reset from the Table 4 power-up defaults (12/13-bit, sign, MSB first, user mode)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: MUX = DI0 DI1 of the last conversion instruction (Table 3), ACQ = acquisition time code (Table 4: 0 = 6, 1 = 10 (power-up), 2 = 18, 3 = 34 CCLK)

pages: p.2 (Figure 1 16-pin: CH0 1 CH1 2 COM3 DOR4 EOC5 VREF- 6 VREF+ 7 DGND8 VA+ 9 CONV10 CS11 DO12 DI13 SCLK14 CCLK15 VD+ 16), p.3-4 (pin descriptions: DI on SCLK rising, DO on SCLK falling, first bit at CS fall, CS low with SCLK low, EOC low while busy), p.5 (operating ratings V+ = VA+ = VD+ 3.0-5.5 V), p.9 (tC 44 tCK max = 8.8 us at 5 MHz), p.10 (tA 7/11/19/35 tCK max, tCAL 4944 tCK, tAZ 76 tCK), p.11 (tACC 60 ns, tDDO 90 ns, t1H/t0H 100 ns), p.28 (Table 1 data out formats), p.29 (Table 3 ADC12130 MUX addressing, Table 4 mode programming: ADC12130 DI0 DI1 DI2-DI5, power-up defaults, Table 5 CONV/PD), p.30 (Table 6 status register DB0-DB8), p.31-32 (configuration sequence, 8-bit instruction, SCLKs per format), p.39 (12-bit + sign two's complement codes)
notModeled: analog side: self-calibration (Auto Cal, tCAL 4944 tCK) and Auto Zero (76 tCK) are accepted as no-ops (EOC does not go low for them; STATUS.CAL stays 0); power-up sequence 700 us

output word length and order (Table 1): 12/13/16/17 bits, MSB or LSB first, with or without sign; the 0 V code is all zeros in every format, so the output is modeled as 13 zero bits then zeros; the formats are recorded in STATUS
the output of an I/O sequence is the result of the PREVIOUS conversion (pipelined); the constant 0 V code makes this invisible

Read Status: the status word is output during the next instruction (modeled with next "[STATUS]"); its bit order on DO (DB0 first assumed) and the status word length are not stated beyond Table 6; PU/PD/CAL in-progress bits stay 0
CONV pin: high = read data only (DI ignored, no conversion started); cannot gate commands on a pin level, so DI is always decoded
DOR output (low while data is shifted out, high after the last bit) is not driven
CS held low continuously (I/O sequences counted by SCLK, first bit on the EOC rising edge); CS falling during a conversion aborts it
CCLK (conversion clock) is not used: conversion time is fixed at fCK = 5 MHz (max acquisition + 44 tCK)
conversion starts when the instruction's 8th bit is in (the datasheet starts acquisition after the instruction / end of the I/O sequence)
multiplexer modes (differential CH0/CH1 vs single-ended to COM, Table 3): codes 0/2 = CH0, 1/3 = CH1 via channelMap
test mode (CH1-CH7 become outputs): STATUS.TEST only
PD pin and A/DIN, MUXOUT pins exist only on the 20/28-pin family members (ADC12132/ADC12138)
variants: ADC12132 (20-pin SSOP, MUXOUT/A/DIN pins) and ADC12138 (8 channels, 28-pin) share the datasheet; same instruction set with wider MUX addresses
